sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.choosePlaneHint: Click a plane or a planar face of the part in the view, a plane in the feature tree, or choose one here.
sketch.exitHint: ✓ keeps the sketch, ✕ discards your changes. Undo and redo work step by step inside the sketch.

toolHints.select: Drag geometry to move it, click to select. Choose a drawing tool in the Sketch tab.
toolHints.line: Click the start point, then each next point. Clicking the start point closes the chain; Esc or a second click ends it.
toolHints.centerline: Like lines; the result is construction geometry (dashed) that does not become part of the profile.
toolHints.cornerRectangle: Click one corner, then the opposite corner (or drag).
toolHints.centerRectangle: Click the center, then a corner (or drag).
toolHints.threePointRectangle: Click both ends of one side, then move sideways to set the width and click. The sides stay perpendicular.
toolHints.parallelogram: Click both ends of one side, then the third corner. Opposite sides stay parallel.
toolHints.circle: Click the center, then a point on the circle (or drag).
toolHints.centerArc: Click the center, then the start point; move in the direction of the arc and click the end point.
toolHints.threePointArc: Click the start point and the end point, then a point the arc passes through.
toolHints.point: Click to place points; on a line or circle they stay on it.
toolHints.snapping: Points snap to end points, midpoints and curves and align with other points (dashed lines); the matching relations are added automatically. Esc leaves the tool.
toolHints.dimension: Click a line, circle or arc, or two entities (points, lines, circles). Move the value to where it belongs – above, beside or along the geometry – and click. Then type the value and press Enter.
toolHints.threePointCircle: Click three points the circle passes through.
toolHints.tangentArc: Click the end point of a line or arc, then where the arc should end. The arc leaves the line or arc tangentially.
toolHints.slot: Click the centers of both ends, then move sideways to set the width and click.
toolHints.polygon: Click the center, then a corner. All sides stay equal; the corners lie on a construction circle.
toolHints.sketchFillet: Set the radius, then click corners where two lines meet. The lines are shortened and joined by a tangent arc with a radius dimension.
toolHints.sketchChamfer: Set the distance, then click corners where two lines meet. Both lines are shortened by the distance and joined by a line.
toolHints.trim: Move over a curve: the piece up to the neighboring crossings turns red; click to remove it. A curve that nothing crosses is removed completely.
toolHints.extend: Move near the end of a line or arc: a dashed preview shows how far it grows; click to extend it up to the next curve.

sketch.noRelations: The selected geometry has no relations yet.

messages.redundantRelation: This relation already follows from the existing relations and dimensions, so it would over-define the sketch.
messages.conflictingRelation: This relation contradicts the existing relations and dimensions.
messages.drivenDimension: This dimension would over-define the sketch, so it was added as a reference dimension that only shows the value.
messages.dimensionNotApplied: The sketch cannot be solved with this value; the dimension keeps its previous value.
messages.invalidDimension: Enter a length greater than 0, or an angle between 0 and 180 degrees.
messages.drivenNotEditable: Reference dimensions show the measured value and cannot be changed.
messages.cornerNotACorner: Click a corner where exactly two lines meet.
messages.cornerTooLarge: The radius or distance is too large for the lines at this corner.
messages.cornerStraight: The two lines continue each other in a straight line; there is no corner.
messages.trimNotACurve: Click on a line, circle or arc.
messages.extendNoTarget: There is no curve to extend to in this direction.
messages.extendConnected: This end is connected to other geometry and cannot be extended.
messages.extendConstrained: Relations or dimensions hold this end in place; delete them to extend it.
messages.transformNoAxis: Select a line as mirror axis as well: a construction line, or select the axis last.
messages.moveBlocked: The selection cannot move there: relations or dimensions hold it in place.
messages.offsetTooLarge: The distance is too large for the selected curves.

sketch.dimensionHint: Double-click a dimension to change its value, drag it to move the value. Delete removes it.
sketch.relationHint: Hovering a symbol highlights the geometry it relates. Delete removes the selected relations.

statusHint.under: Blue geometry can still move. Add relations and dimensions until everything is dark.
statusHint.full: Every point and curve is determined by relations and dimensions.
statusHint.over: Relations or dimensions contradict each other; the affected geometry is red. Delete one of the conflicting entries below.

transform.title: Copy and move
transform.mirrorHint: Mirrors the selection about the selected construction line (or the line selected last). Mirrored points stay symmetric.
transform.offsetHint: Closed outlines and circles grow outwards (inwards with "Other side"); open chains move to the left of their direction. Lines stay parallel, arcs keep their centers, and the first line gets the distance as a dimension.
